---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem
title: "[Bug]: "
---

## Before submitting

Do not include secrets, credentials, tokens, personal data, local absolute paths, usernames, hostnames, raw logs, session transcripts, environment dumps, private project names, or vulnerability details.

If this report concerns a security vulnerability, do not continue here. Follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) to report it privately.

## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior.

## Public-safe reproduction

List minimal, sanitized steps that reproduce the problem. Replace private or machine-specific values with clear placeholders.

## Expected behavior

Describe what you expected instead.

## Additional context

Share only public-safe context that helps explain the problem.
